architecture_upgrade: CCCXLVI compared one-sector, nuisance, and free-channel alternatives. CCCXLVII generalizes the response identity to multiple spectral sectors X_a, allowing model comparison between one-sector, structured multi-sector, and free-channel alternatives.

checks.name: one-sector data BIC selects one-sector model
two-sector data BIC selects geometry/response split
free-channel model exactly fits unstructured data

dimensionless_kernel.multi_sector_identity: channels share scale by sector assignment a(i)
dimensionless_kernel.one_sector_identity: all channels share one scale X

honesty_boundary: Sector assignments here are synthetic hypotheses. Real use requires deriving sector maps from W33 operators or physical channel identifications.
theorem: If a response packet cannot satisfy one common scale, the next controlled extension is a sector map a(i) with X_i=X_{a(i)}+noise_i. Structured multi-sector models can be selected against the one-sector model and against the saturated free-channel alternative by GLS, AIC, and BIC.
title: Multi-Sector Extension Compiler
